svg.title: A - Excitation structure of the training design
svg.desc: Normalised singular-value spectra of the standardised training design [1, P] for regimes P1, P2, P3 and L0, per network. n = 1 design per regime over the 384 training steps (L0 shares P1's PV seeds and differs only in its training loads). No uncertainty is shown: these are the realised spectra of one design each. Source: results/physics_<network>_<regime>.json, field excitation.singular_values and excitation.pv_corr_mean. Values are clipped at 1e-16 of the largest so that L0's rank-deficient tail fits a logarithmic axis; L0's stored condition number is the float maximum and is reported as inf (rank-deficient). Contains information from SimBench (simbench.de), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). See analysis/export_envelope_shift/DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md.
